# UnitedHealthcare

> UnitedHealthcare is a comprehensive health insurance provider offering Medicare, Medicaid, ACA marketplace, employer group, individual and family, and supplemental plans with digital tools and member wellness resources.

UnitedHealthcare serves diverse populations through multiple insurance segments including Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Community Plans, ACA marketplace coverage, and employer-sponsored benefits. The site provides plan shopping, member resources, and educational content about health insurance fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Medicare Advantage
- Medicare Supplement (Medigap)
- Medicaid
- ACA Marketplace
- Affordable Care Act
- Employer Group Plans
- Individual & Family Plans
- UnitedHealthcare App
- Dual Special Needs Plans (D-SNP)
- Telehealth Services
- Wellness Programs
- Plan Comparison
- Open Enrollment
- Coverage Options
- Supplemental Plans

## Core Insurance Plans

- [Health insurance plans | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com): UnitedHealthcare homepage showcasing Medicare, Medicaid, individual and employer plans.
- [Shop all UnitedHealthcare insurance plans | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/shop-online-health-insurance-plans): Central shopping hub for all UnitedHealthcare insurance plans across segments.
- [Medicare Coverage Options from UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/medicare): UnitedHealthcare Medicare plans including Advantage, Medigap, and special needs.
- [UnitedHealthcare Community Plan](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan): Community Plan for Medicaid and Medicare coverage with eligibility information.
- [Health insurance for individuals & families | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families): Individual and family health insurance plans with quotes and ACA marketplace options.
- [Group health insurance for employers | Employer | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/employer): Group health insurance plans for small and large employers with pharmacy benefits.

## Marketplace & Specialized Coverage

- [Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/aca-marketplace): ACA Marketplace plans for individuals and families with subsidy eligibility.
- [Health plans through work | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/health-plans-through-work): Employer-sponsored health plans with digital tools and telehealth services.
- [Short term health insurance | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/short-term-health-insurance): Short-term and TriTerm Medical plans for temporary coverage gaps.
- [Supplemental health insurance | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans): Supplemental dental, vision, and accident insurance plans for individuals.

## Member Resources & Support

- [UnitedHealthcare app | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/unitedhealthcare-app): UnitedHealthcare mobile app for plan management, claims, and provider search.
- [Member support, wellness and rewards programs | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/wellness-rewards-programs): Wellness programs including Real Appeal, HouseCalls, and smoking cessation resources.

## Health Insurance Education

- [Understanding health insurance | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance): Comprehensive health insurance education hub covering basics and plan types.
- [How does health insurance work? | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/how-does-health-insurance-work): Health insurance basics guide covering costs, coverage, and plan types.
- [What are the different types of health insurance? | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/types-of-health-insurance): Guide to health insurance types including ACA, Medicare, Medicaid, and COBRA.
- [Understanding health insurance costs | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/understanding-health-insurance-costs): Explanation of premiums, deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance costs.
- [What is open enrollment? | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/open-enrollment): Open enrollment guide for ACA, Medicare, Medicaid, and employer coverage.
- [Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/understanding-health-insurance/how-does-health-insurance-work/summary-of-benefits-and-coverage): SBC guide for understanding and comparing health plan benefits and coverage.

## Optional

- [Advertising Policy | UnitedHealthcare](https://www.uhc.com/legal/advertising-policy): UnitedHealthcare advertising policy and guidelines for website content.
